manual_review: Rename stays in original caller context; context element only labels it, no outer transaction.
GC/author/finish tokens differ; task and transaction identities are namespaced by database.
Main SQLite transaction is selected to span rename receipt; trigger-sync and nested DAO END are excluded.
Eleven disjoint wall intervals cover request to return; BEGIN/END CPU differences are same-thread only.
Before/after DELETE observations include callback overhead, not pure SQL execution or exact lock duration.
All producer coroutines finish or cancel/join before writer-ledger drain; terminal event is published first.
Unfinished writer ledger prevents helper close/delete and fails the diagnostic; no silent timeout-to-null.
Trace validation is separate from quiescence, so overflow still allows safe helper cleanup after real exits.
Collector and author helpers each receive a close attempt even if closing the other fails.
JSON/status writes occur after measured work; partial values and first failure are retained.
No resampling, dropped-sample pass, natural/conditional pooling or competition quantiles below20.
